identity.real_world_identity_notes: The observation matches the 2021 Toyota Corolla entry in AMS2 and the exact Toyota Corolla body covered by the CBA 2021 annex. The real car is a category-only Stock Car built on the common JL Racing platform, not a road Corolla or Corolla GR-S. The 2020 and 2022 Corolla records remain separate season-specific identities.

The official AMS2 listing, exact CBA 2021 Toyota Corolla annex, category regulation, and common platform annex agree on the season, body identity, and platform.

claims.basis: The official AMS2 class listing names Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2021. The CBA Toyota annex explicitly complements the 2021 Stock Car technical regulation and covers the Stock Car Toyota Corolla, while the platform annex defines the common 2021 category hardware.

CBA Article 13 establishes six forward ratios, the X-TRAC 396B023, and semiautomatic paddle actuation. The reviewed exact-year sources do not establish selector pattern, launch or running-shift technique, cut/blip behavior, or wheel topology, so those real-car baseline fields remain unknown.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

archetype.basis: The exact real-car sources establish gearbox hardware but leave launch and running-shift technique unknown, so multiple registered control archetypes remain compatible.

driver_summary: Stock car on a paddle semi-automatic: it cuts the upshift and blips the downshift for you. Whether it needs a clutch to pull away was not established by the drive, so treat the start as unrecorded rather than clutch-free.
